parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The streaming domain of the streamer.

parameters.name: MixStreamId
parameters.description: The stream mixing task ID. If you created a stream mixing task by calling the [CreateMixStream operation](~~2848087~~), check the MixStreamId parameter returned by the CreateMixStream operation.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than **0** and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Default value: **1000**.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name of the stream mixing task.
